rdfs:label: inverseOf
rdfs:comment: Asserts that two OWL properties are inverses — `A p1 B` if and only if `B p2 A`.
notes: Reasoners use this to materialise the reverse direction without storing both. Classic pairs: `dcterms:isPartOf` / `dcterms:hasPart`, `prov:wasGeneratedBy` / `prov:generated`, `foaf:made` / `foaf:maker`, `skos:broader` / `skos:narrower`. Symmetric properties (`owl:sameAs`, `skos:related`) are their own inverse.

history.note: Removed incorrect as:followers/as:following pair and foaf:knows-as-symmetric claim; added SymmetricProperty to seeAlso.
